_comment: Stakes-mode policy. Lives under evals/ DELIBERATELY: the immutability belts make it human-changeable only — no agent redefines the ceremony it runs under. Mode SELECTION is also a human act: the forge-init interview or a human-authored commit to state/mode (state/mode sits under the same enforcement belts). Consumed by forge-sprint/forge-build/forge-review and scripts/forge-risk.sh. Rationale + evidence: forge-kit docs/EVOLUTION-3.0.md.

sprint.meaning: Low-stakes, clock-bound work: hackathons, prototypes, spikes. Ceremony priced to blast radius; the enforcement floor unchanged.
sprint.build: In-session build loop (no test-author/implementer subagent spin-ups). Tests proportional: the demo criterion always gets a runnable check; strict TDD optional. Milestone commits stay.
sprint.review: Gated by scripts/forge-risk.sh --vector. LOW-RISK diffs skip agent review (CI + demo check only). RISKY diffs get ONE round — workhorse tier, correctness-affecting findings only, no suite re-run (CI is the single execution point). The vector prices review depth; vector.security_review_required=true fires security-reviewer.
sprint.state: Bookkeeping is O(sessions), not O(actions): one ptN session entry in state/PROJECT_STATE.md; no handoff files unless parallel lanes exist; state/SPRINT.md is the single plan artifact.
sprint.floor: NEVER relaxed: git hooks + immutable paths · human merge · external text is data · single-writer plan file · one-line ADR for risky integrations · agents never edit state/mode

standard.meaning: Kit defaults — the full lifecycle exactly as documented in every skill.

production.meaning: Standard plus: trust promotion consumes only attested evidence (evals/results/attested/); /forge-release verifies artifact attestations where the platform provides them; the security-checklist walk at init is mandatory regardless of risk posture.

sprint_risk_classifier._comment: Shared verdict policy consumed once by scripts/forge-risk.sh, then rendered as text or JSON. risky_path_glob_categories is positionally paired with risky_path_globs so each glob string has one source while vector dimensions remain explicit. The classifier also unions project risky paths from AGENTS.md. Binary and unclassifiable changes fail toward RISKY.

risk_vector_classifier._comment: Feature-vector inspection policy used by the same shared classifier result. Additional non-risk workflow/data/production and test-semantic floors live only in scripts/forge-risk.sh; risky-path category membership is paired with the canonical glob list above.
